# GraphCheck Action

The publishable Action now lives in the standalone
[`graphora/graphcheck-action`](https://github.com/graphora/graphcheck-action) repository.

Use it from workflows with:

```yaml
- uses: graphora/graphcheck-action@v1
```

See the [standalone README](https://github.com/graphora/graphcheck-action#readme) for inputs,
version pinning, exit-code behavior, and artifact details.
